definitions.bytes: CXL.mem payload bytes; atomic transfers count in both directions
definitions.latency: first host-facing CXL timing attempt to successful host response
definitions.device_service: backend acceptance to backend response; includes backend internal scheduling
definitions.activity: union of observed payload-bearing crossbar serialization intervals; null without a modeled transport
definitions.queue: request and response FIFOs reported separately; atomic occupies read-class queue once
definitions.cycles: blocked ticks divided by each node clock period; global cycles unavailable for mixed clocks
definitions.phase: issue counters and transfer events in [begin,end); latencies of completions in [begin,end)
definitions.utilization: payload bytes / elapsed seconds / configured directional payload capacity
definitions.oversubscription: host-issued endpoint demand (port-arrival demand for links) exceeding configured window capacity; not proof of modeled throttling
definitions.bandwidth_stall_cycles: actual crossbar serialization occupancy intersected with CXL arbitration waiting; FIFO-only nodes expose generic backpressure
